answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a small refundable stake that thaws only like a glacier: slowly, across many epochs of verified useful work. Every epoch of honest attestation adds one verifiable layer, like strata in shale, so reputation is built gradually and cannot be bought in bulk. Price the stake like saffron: trivial for one genuine agent, but an attacker minting ten thousand fake identities must pay that price ten thousand times, turning cheap forgery into a loss-making harvest, while idle fakes simply forfeit their bonds.
